# Tumblr

> Tumblr is a social media platform for content creation, sharing, and community engagement with mobile apps and browser extensions.

Tumblr is a microblogging and social networking platform owned by Automattic, headquartered in San Francisco. It provides tools for users to create, share, and discover content across web and mobile platforms.

## Key Topics

- Social networking
- Content creation
- Community
- Mobile apps
- iOS/Android
- Browser extensions
- Platform overview
- User accounts
- Privacy policy
- Terms of service
- GDPR compliance

- Chrome extension
- Firefox extension
- Automattic

## Platform Overview

- [About Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/about): Overview of Tumblr platform, company history, and community mission

## Mobile & Desktop Apps

- [Get the Apps | Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Download Tumblr apps for iPhone, iPad, Android, Chrome, Firefox

## Help & Support

- [Tumblr Help Center – Find support resources and documentation for Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/help): Help center with guides for posting, accounts, premium features, mobile
- [Your Advertising Choices – Tumblr Help Center](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/articles/360041012973-Your-Advertising-Choices): Guide to advertising preferences, opt-out options, and cookie consent

- [Tumblr Terms of Service](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service): Legal terms of service and user conduct guidelines for Tumblr

- [Tumblr Privacy Policy (International)](https://www.tumblr.com/privacy/en): Privacy policy covering data collection, user information handling
